title: Blight
tagline: Drag to aim, release to shoot and match 3 bubbles

fr.tagline: Vise, tire, aligne trois bulles. La moisissure ne redescend que si tu lui coupes la route.

en.tagline: Aim, shoot, match three bubbles. The spreading blight only falls if you cut it off.

description: Drag to aim, release to fire and match 3 bubbles to pop them. Rainbow supers chain-detonate; the spreading blight only falls if you cut it off.
